set.body: Make scale training and row-drop behavior explicit in the plot pipeline. Acceptance: declared vs trained scales are represented separately; continuous/discrete x/y/color/fill/size training is deterministic; dropped rows carry typed reasons such as missing aesthetic, transform-domain failure, non-finite position, or scale out-of-domain; tests cover log10 zero/negative values, discrete unknown levels, and clean Pass behavior on JVM and JS.
set.title: Graphics: formalize scale training and row diagnostics
